description: This file defines the class FormatWithActivity, which implements ValueFormatter. It formats a value related to project activities by fetching activity details via a timesheet service, specifically returning the activity name if the activity exists.

classes.name: FormatWithActivity
classes.description: A class that implements ValueFormatter to provide a formatted string representation of a project activity based on an activity ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the activity for a given activity ID if the activity exists; otherwise, returns null.
